suite.description: Public, deterministic operator workload specification for budgeted search. No new GPU results are supplied for this suite.
suite.input_policy: Seeded random tensors; not recorded activations or licensed driving data.
suite.memory_boundary: Peak live allocated increase above resident inputs, including output; not full-model memory or allocator reservation.
suite.provenance: Test shapes match selected historical Vista profile shapes. Train/validation shapes are constructed from the same operator families. These are openly specified splits, not secret or historically untouched holdouts.
suite.quality_policy: Reference-output shape/dtype/finiteness and dtype-specific allclose; input immutability. Not video perceptual quality.
suite.timing_boundary: Single isolated operator invocation, CUDA events; initialization, compilation, input creation, warmups, correctness and export excluded but charged to wall time.

use: Measured-data replay for configuration-search research; not fresh GPU execution or a live confirmation result.
